_comment_intent: Single source of truth: REFACTOR-MCP.md §6.1 + PROTOCOLS.md §1.3 + §3.1. Both A2A skills (Path A) and MCP tool surfaces (Path B) are declared so one image lists into the Marketplace under either category. KR-gap disclosure section per docs/KR-GAP-DISCLOSURE.md.
name: Influencer Research Agent (TikTok)
description: Given a brand brief, finds and ranks TikTok creators by engagement and brief-fit. Powered by Social Seeding's public-data TikTok pipeline (RapidAPI-mediated; no TikTok Research API). Returns a structured top-10 with reasoning, engagement-rate, and source attribution.

additionalInterfaces._comment: Live Cloud Run deploy (ss-mcp-prod, us-central1) — the canonical, verified-callable Track-3 endpoint.
Planned vanity domain — DNS cutover pending (PHASE-5-STATUS O-C); NOT yet live, do not call.

extensions.description: AP2 Intent Mandate (D27) — declared as optional; the v1 surface accepts but does not yet require AP2.

oidc._comment: Identity Platform tenant OIDC discovery (D19). PROJECT_ID is substituted at deploy time by terraform/cloud-run-service.yaml. CALLER identity — gates who may invoke.

mutualTLS.description: A2A v0.3 mutual-TLS — peers authenticate by client certificate at the transport layer (no identity in the payload). The agent presents the workload-identity client cert tied to the SPIFFE ID in `identity` below. AGENT identity — proves who this agent is. DECLARED/INTENDED posture: only the transport-layer mTLS half is NOT YET ENFORCED on the live demo deployment; the OIDC half (REQUIRE_AUTH=true) IS enforced — unauthenticated callers receive HTTP 401 (verified 2026-05-28 against the production *.run.app URL). mTLS enforcement is pending the O7 Agent Gateway Private-Preview allowlist. See AGENT-IDENTITY.md §7 + x-securityPosture below.

x-securityPosture._comment: Honest, non-secret disclosure per RULES.md Professional Honesty + AGENT-IDENTITY.md §7. The mutualTLS scheme and the `identity` block are the DECLARED/INTENDED posture; the demo deployment does not yet enforce them. Authority: DECISIONS.md D44 (Agent Gateway / Agent Identity), D48 (crypto ID), D32 (audit/SIEM), D7 (timeline).
x-securityPosture.intendedPosture: mutualTLS (A2A v0.3 transport-layer client-cert auth) + SPIFFE workload identity + caller OIDC/OAuth

demoDeployment.verifiedBy: curl -sX POST https://ss-mcp-server-1049119860518.us-central1.run.app/v1/message:send -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{}' -> HTTP 401 {"error":"invalid_request","error_description":"Authorization header missing"}
demoDeployment.note: The Track-3 demo Cloud Run service (ss-mcp-prod, us-central1) enforces REQUIRE_AUTH=true on the application layer (verified 2026-05-28: unauthenticated POST /v1/message:send returns HTTP 401). The Dockerfile default of REQUIRE_AUTH=false is overridden by cloud-run-service.yaml's env binding. Transport-layer mTLS is still NOT enforced; pending O7. The previous wording here (claiming the live demo was REQUIRE_AUTH=false) was stale — see DECISIONS.md D44 + X4 in docs/IMPROVEMENT-MASTER-PLAN.md.

productionPosture.note: Production sets REQUIRE_AUTH=true (cloud-run-service.yaml) and verifies caller OIDC/OAuth per request; mutualTLS transport enforcement is pending O7 Agent Gateway Private-Preview allowlist (DECISIONS.md §6 O7).

identity._comment: Agent Identity (designed_guide.pdf p.7 + DECISIONS.md D48). Unique cryptographic ID for this agent, anchored by the Cloud Run workload-identity service account `tiktok-mcp-runner` (cloud-run-service.yaml). Non-secret discovery metadata; the private key is GCP-managed + auto-rotated and never on disk. Full design: AGENT-IDENTITY.md.

skills.name: Plan and rank TikTok creators
skills.description: Plans queries, sources candidates across language variants, fetches engagement metrics, and returns a ranked top-10 with reasoning. Honors the per-tool daily quotas declared in the linked MCP server.
examples: Find 10 vegan-skincare TikTok creators in Korea for a Gen-Z launch.
Source US fitness creators 50k-200k followers with >5% engagement.
Identify Japanese beauty creators discussing fragrance-free skincare.

skills.name: Get approved brand assets (DAM)
skills.description: DAM-style skill (designed_guide.pdf Build Example #2): returns a brand's approved logos / product imagery + an on-brand compliance verdict for a supplied post media URI. Invoked over A2A by the content_verify marketing agent to keep creator posts on-brand. DEMO DAM stand-in for a customer's real Digital Asset Manager; the A2A transport is genuine.
examples: Return approved logos for 'Freshly' and verify the post thumbnail is on-brand.
Get the brand-asset catalog + compliance verdict for a detected creator post.
skills._a2a_binding: POST /v1/message:send with a data part {skill:'get_brand_assets', brand_name, post_media_url}; direct alias POST /a2a/skills/get_brand_assets
skills._build_example_2: Consumed by content_verify (Track-2 Tier-1 agent #7) via ss_agents.tools.dam_get_brand_assets -> a2a_invoke. Honest scope: demo DAM stand-in; transport real.

_a2a_intents._comment: Track 3 official requirement #6 (designed_guide.pdf p.6) — the A2A intents this agent EXPOSES and CONSUMES. Human-readable manifest: A2A-INTENTS.md. Per DECISIONS.md D48.
_a2a_intents.cross_call_proof: Two real A2A cross-component edges: (1) Track-2 coordinator (M1) A2A-invokes plan_creator_search via ss_agents.tools.a2a_invoke (D45). (2) Track-2 content_verify A2A-invokes the DAM-style get_brand_assets skill via ss_agents.tools.dam_get_brand_assets -> a2a_invoke (Build Example #2, transport-exact).

_build_example_2_match._comment: designed_guide.pdf p.7 Build Example #2 (Gemini multimodal marketing agent → A2A → DAM Agent for approved brand logos, staying on-brand/compliant) maps 1:1 to Social Seeding's content_verify agent. As of W3/Seam-C the brand-asset check crosses a REAL A2A v0.3 hop (content_verify → dam_get_brand_assets → a2a_invoke → this server's get_brand_assets DAM skill) — transport-exact, not an in-process call. Per DECISIONS.md D45 + D48. Honest scope: the A2A transport is genuine; the DAM endpoint is a demo stand-in for a customer's real Digital Asset Manager; live endpoint deploy is operator-gated. See A2A-INTENTS.md §5.
_build_example_2_match.pdf_role: marketing agent + multimodal + A2A → internal DAM Agent (approved brand logos / product imagery) for on-brand compliance
_build_example_2_match.transport: a2a-v0.3 (real) — content_verify → ss_agents.tools.dam_get_brand_assets → a2a_invoke (message/send) → get_brand_assets DAM skill
